Pocketry · 6 November 2026 · research evaluation

Current outlines versus the combined experiment

Report-only prototype. The experiment is not enabled in the preview app. The app still uses the current PR default.

All 36 distinct tools and attachments on white Pocketry sheets, one selected region per subject. The current default appears in magenta and one fixed combined experimental policy in green. Use “Include original detector” to also see the detector from before this PR.

The experiment combines raw and repaired edge regions, a finer bounded sensitivity search, guarded foreground evidence, and local preservation checks. Every subject uses the same rules. No manual outline edits, per-photo sensitivity choices, or best-of-several-result substitutions are used. The usual automatic line/curve cleanup runs afterward, with curves represented by points.

5Improved
2Mixed
5Regressed
24Unchanged

12 final outlines changed; 24 stayed identical. Foreground checkpoints show new coverage in 1 of the 36 subjects and new losses in 0. These checks do not establish correct recesses or exclude shadows: visual review found regressions even where all foreground points remained covered.

Median per-tool desktop time: 0.77 → 0.81 seconds. Per-tool timings below include unchanged results that became slower. Phone performance remains untested.

The combined policy is not ready to adopt. The DeWalt, syringe and three long drivers improve, while shadows and lost recesses cause the five regressions. The reflective tube and transparent hubs remain difficult.

Method, timing and limitations

Current means the unchanged application implementation at 5ce47e25. Experimental means an isolated evaluation-only selector; it is not imported by the app. Both receive identical perspective-corrected crop pixels, calibration, reference-strip regions, Auto sensitivity and default smoothing. The deburring tool’s support wire is excluded by the same close region on both sides. Each Wiha from the group photo is selected individually. Reference-strip estimates are marked amber.

Current and experimental times are medians of three fresh full detections, including TEED inference, reconstruction, any color fallback and automatic line/curve cleanup. Runs alternate order on the same desktop using Node 22 and the shipped OpenCV CPU/WASM. Runtime initialization, model download, photo loading and calibration are excluded. Inference is not reused between measured runs. Original-detector times are retained historical measurements from the earlier report and are labeled accordingly.

Additional checks replayed 115 cached views; all 36 fresh experimental outputs matched those replays exactly. No new annotated tool merges or foreground-point losses appeared, but visual review still found the regressions shown above. A synthetic unseeded thin shaft remains a known failing case. These checks do not qualify the prototype for adoption.

These are desktop measurements. Phone performance, peak memory and physical fit remain untested. The experimental policy was frozen before this full comparison. Development photos overlap the evaluation set, so this is not a held-out accuracy benchmark. Added probes check named features at specific locations, not exact widths or the entire boundary. Visual review and explicit missing-feature checks supplement contour counts and overlap metrics.

Unsupported experimental proposals retain the existing result; the report does not replace them with individually chosen diagnostic successes. Brighter material can remain confused with paper, attached printing can remain visible, and transparent parts or unseeded tips remain unresolved. A successful curve fit does not establish a correct silhouette.

Open Pocketry · current default · PR #226

Dependencies and shipped third-party assets: none added or changed. Report crops are maintainer-provided photos with EXIF metadata removed. Detailed research records remain local.
